mode: Independent source and specification inspection; no runtime execution

findings.issue: The one-POST assertion requires one mounted Timeout controller. Direct exported relogin callers create a POST per invocation.
findings.consequence: The current fixture wording can classify expected direct-service behavior as a regression.
findings.next_action: Name the same mounted controller extend action. Record that every invocation enters that one controller.

findings.issue: Unresolved owned operations is undefined. Mounted Home intentionally retains expiry timers and a visibility listener.
findings.consequence: A zero-resource assertion can fail valid mounted behavior or pass vacuously after forced cleanup.
findings.next_action: Separate pending network requests from active lifecycle resources. Assert zero pending requests after settlement. Compare timers/listeners to mounted baseline, then assert cleanup after explicit unmount.

findings.issue: An access-valid late callback does not guarantee an acquisition POST. Visibility, prompt, logout, refresh reuse, and an existing pending acquisition also guard the path.
findings.consequence: The fixture can legitimately produce zero new POSTs under the current preconditions.
findings.next_action: Specify visible state, no dialog/logout, usable access, no existing acquisition, and refresh validity at or below the three-hour reuse window.

findings.issue: Target variants omit the at-least-30-second access precondition used by the linked activity criteria. Key repeat cadence is also unspecified.
findings.consequence: The case may measure an expired or insufficiently valid session instead of the intended activity behavior.
findings.next_action: Keep target assertions. Add the source criterion precondition. State whether repeat cadence is controlled at 100 milliseconds or mark the cadence variant as proposed.

findings.issue: A same-origin nested scroll pane is not established as a policy exception to the requested scroll behavior.
findings.evidence: Requirement AC-3 at knowledge/candidates/requirements/REQ-active-session-renewal.md:201-206; requested scope includes user habits and workspaces.
findings.consequence: Labeling ordinary nested scrolling policy-open can weaken the existing target by treating missing implementation as missing intent.
findings.next_action: Define an ordinary same-origin child pane and retain the AC-3 target. Keep cross-origin iframe eligibility separate and unresolved.

findings.issue: Different header casings with separate values may be normalized or combined by browser HTTP and AxiosHeaders.
findings.evidence: succes.response.handler.ts:45-47 prioritizes a plain-object lowercase key; actual response parsing happens before this interceptor.
findings.consequence: A direct interceptor-object fixture cannot establish browser reachability of two distinct casing keys.
findings.next_action: Classify the plain-object precedence case as controlled integration. For browser E2E, observe actual duplicate-header normalization and retain the resulting value.

findings.issue: Several Timeout source references end at line 177 or 205. The exact committed file has 169 lines.
findings.consequence: Source ranges cannot resolve to their stated committed content.
findings.next_action: Refresh all source ranges against committed bytes. Use 131-155 for pending/manual action and 79-111 for deadline guards.

findings.issue: Distinct browser storage objects do not establish isolated stored credential values.
findings.evidence: Normal and private context isolation is a browser boundary; each Window exposes a distinct Storage wrapper.
findings.consequence: The assertion can pass while credential material is copied through another path.
findings.next_action: Assert no shared credential hashes or protected cross-principal data. Record distinct storage wrappers only as supplemental context.

findings.issue: Malformed-success F012 overlaps the concrete missing-access and invalid-payload partition cases.
findings.evidence: Both deliver HTTP 200 without usable access through the real interceptor and expect zero successful closure.
findings.consequence: Counting the generic umbrella as an independent behavior can inflate coverage totals.
findings.next_action: Keep F012 as an umbrella linked to concrete payload partitions or name a distinct malformed response shape.

preserved_targets: AC-1 through AC-4 remain target behavior even where current source fails.

limitations: Automated checks cover JSON serialization and unique finding IDs only.
Automated checks do not check the complete approved dictionary or grammar rules.
